client: owner's existing signed-in session in the Claude desktop browser pane, test host in Pakistan (edge bom1); read-only GETs only

method.fullPage: 8 sequential same-origin fetch() of each admin page with the session cookie, cache: no-store; TTFB and total
method.clickNavigation: 3 rounds of real sidebar-link clicks (Next.js client navigation); duration of the RSC request from the Resource Timing API (immune to hidden-tab timer throttling)

fullPage_ms._format: [TTFB p50, TTFB p95]; all 26 pages HTTP 200, no error text

clickNavigation_ms._format: [p50, p95] of 3 samples each; max 862 ms = first (cold) product-list navigation

notes: Self-crafted RSC fetches returned 500 because the router-state header was synthetic; real clicks return 200.
